info.name: Create Import Job for a New Table (Asynchronous)

params.name: CONFIG
params.description: JSONObject with configuration to initiate a new import job. (Refer `BulkImportConfigNewTable` schema). Value must be stringified and URL-encoded.

items.docs:
Create an import job to import data into a new table asynchronously. Max allowed file size is 100 MB.

Workflow of Asynchronous Import API:

1. Create Import Job:
   - Initiate the import by calling the Create Import Job API.
   - A unique JOBID will be returned in the response, which serves as the reference for tracking the import job.

2. Check Job Status:
   - Use the Get Import Job Details API to monitor the status of the import job.

info.name: Create Import Job for an Existing Table (Asynchronous)

params.name: CONFIG
params.description: JSONObject with configuration to initiate a new import job. (Refer `BulkImportConfigExitingTable` schema). Value must be stringified and URL-encoded.

items.docs:
Create an import job to import data into a specified existing table asynchronously. Max allowed file size is 100 MB. 

Workflow of Asynchronous Import API:

1. Create Import Job:
   - Initiate the import by calling the Create Import Job API.
   - A unique JOBID will be returned in the response, which serves as the reference for tracking the import job.

2. Check Job Status:
   - Use the Get Import Job Details API to monitor the status of the import job.
   - The JOBID must be used in the request

params.name: job-id
params.description: The unique identifier of the import/export job.

items.docs: Returns details of the specified asynchronous import job.
